nodes.text: The platform team's quarter in review: releases, reliability, and the road to Q1.
Roadmap for the next two quarters
Now, next and later, with owners
Twelve releases, three that changed how the platform runs.
Every merge ships within the hour, behind a flag, with an automated canary. Deploy frequency tripled.
Read replicas in two regions, failover rehearsed monthly. The base of the four-nines target.
Enterprise sign-in and a searchable audit trail, live for four customers in the first week.
Up from 1.8 per day, driven by the release train and automated canary checks.
Failover rework and multi-region reads put four nines within reach.
Every release behind a flag; the canary caught the two that would have rolled back.
From the first alert to the change named in the channel.
The release train landed in August; September ran at three times the Q2 pace with no rollbacks.
Now, next and later, each with an owning squad. Dates shift; the order does not.
Multiplayer cursors, presence and comment threads on nodes.
Full editing without a connection; sync on return.
Generate and edit images with brand-safe style presets.
SCIM, regional data residency and the audit export.
The platform squad is two people short of the H2 plan. Both roles are open; referrals close them faster.
The identity provider contract for the enterprise tier. Pays back on the second customer.
Three customers willing to test the AI media studio in December, before general release.

Help us ship
the next quarter
Three asks: two backend hires, SSO budget, and design partner intros. Office hours every Thursday.
